about: MWManager's own notes for option choices, shown in the option window after the FOMOD text, the packaged readmes and the mod page. A mod matches by its Nexus id or by a package-folder pattern; each option pattern is matched (case-insensitive, * and ? wildcards, / or \) against the option's label, key, file name and path inside the package. '*' notes the whole package.

options.*AATL_Data.esp: Modder's resource: this plugin is for mod authors working in the Construction Set. Players do not need it; leave it unchecked.

options.*Firemoth Remover*: Only enable this plugin if you would prefer the official add-on version of Siege at Firemoth. Tamriel Rebuilt includes an extensive overhaul of that add-on, and this plugin removes it.
